entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-jg4p-7fhp-p32p: @hapi/content: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in HTTP header parsing
entry.content:
@hapi/content: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in HTTP header parsing

Aliases: CVE-2026-115728, CVE-2026-35213

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • @hapi/content — fixed in 6.0.1

All versions of `@hapi/content` through 6.0.0 are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via crafted HTTP header values. Three regular expressions used to parse `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition` headers contain patterns susceptible to catastrophic backtracking. This has been fixed in v6.0.1. ### Impact Denial of Service. An unauthenticated remote attacker can cause a Node.js process to become unresponsive by sending a single HTTP request with a maliciously crafted header value. ### Patches Fixed by tightening all three regular expressions to eliminate backtracking. ### Workarounds There are no known workarounds. Upgrade to the patched version.

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m: multer vulnerable to Denial of Service via a pending asynchronous fileFilter after request teardown
entry.content:
multer vulnerable to Denial of Service via a pending asynchronous fileFilter after request teardown

Aliases: CVE-2026-113872

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H

Affected:

  • multer — fixed in 2.5.0

### Impact When `multer` is configured with an asynchronous `fileFilter`, a single request can crash the Node.js process.
